openings.claim: Test whether bridge roof clearance actually breaks corner coupling by temporarily blocking one roof gap while preserving the rim-supported carrier.
openings.delta: Keep the removable padded guide bridges and lateral stops proposed previously. Change only left roof contact: insert the second supplied 1 mm card between roof and hatch for the rival configuration, then remove it for the candidate. Drill only strips; keep cards and cord-retained hardware recoverable and withdraw bridges completely for inspection.
openings.prediction: Nearest rival: identical bridges with left roof clearance blocked. If roof contact transmits asymmetric corner pressure, blocking should increase opposite-corner lift, especially with the right-rim disturbance; unblocked bridges should retain position with less lift. Equal results weaken this explanation; card interference, measurement resolution or unchanged roof contact could also conceal a difference. No effect is established.
openings.probe: Inspect fit first. Run two blocked-roof closure/pull trials, centered and right-rim disturbed, using both cards during the latter. Remove the roof card; run ten unblocked opening cycles with one closure/20 N pull each, final closure right-rim disturbed. Record marked displacement, corner lift before and after pulling, reopening seconds and seal tears. Compare disturbed trials and assess candidate cycle ten against 1 mm, 20 N and 30 seconds. Twelve trials, two configurations, no repeats; the rival earns no durability claim. Stop on damage.
assumptions: Rim access, strip reach, bolt lengths and independent rim bearing remain indispensable unknowns; reject infeasible geometry without changing original parts.
The roof card must change left contact without moving stops or requiring permanent deformation; otherwise the intervention is uninterpretable.
Card-induced binding, lateral clearance above 1 mm, rocking, pad slip or seal tears defeat the candidate.
Fabrication must fit ninety minutes and observation twenty; full inspection clearance and thirty-second reopening remain unverified.

assessment: A geometry-dependent causal probe, not deployment. Roof blocking isolates a proposed dependency more closely but cannot establish useful performance without the supplied outcome checks.

lineage.reason: Original yoke comparator exceeds this branch’s two-configuration allowance.
Preserves rim-supported registration; replaces the yoke comparison with reversible roof-contact blocking.
